calls.video_title: The Entire Market Relies On These Stocks
calls.thesis: HOLD (first tracked Joseph call on TSM): no reason to sell — near-monopoly at the top of the AI food chain, benefits whichever chip designer wins, lower expectations than ASML at 21x forward P/E and 1.5% FCF yield; expects great earnings.
calls.bull_case: AI/robotics/device demand keeps chip production growing for a decade.

calls.thesis: Reiterates BUY: TSMC is "the best manufacturing company in the world, period" — sold-out capacity, record 34% ROIC, 55.8% trailing operating margins (57% forecast next quarter), Q3 revenue expected +37% YoY. SpaceX/Tesla Terrafab fab talks (Musk confirmed on X Oct 3) are pure upside not in his numbers. DCF fair value $670 vs ~$484.
calls.base_case: DCF fair value $670 (~38% upside); forward PE ~22 looks attractive given how much the business has improved.
calls.bull_case: Terrafab deal lands — TSMC builds/operates a new fab with SpaceX/Tesla committing to buy output; adds to Apple/Nvidia/AMD customer base; full utilization keeps margins expanding.
calls.bear_case: Geographic diversification is less profitable (US/Japan/Europe fabs cost more than Taiwan); management warns long-term margins will compress; Intel could win the Terrafab deal as the US-based option.

calls.thesis: DCF fair value $647 vs $451 (~43% upside); does not own yet, very interested in buying.

calls.video_title: Is Taiwan Semiconductor Stock an Undervalued AI Stock to Buy Right Now? | TSM STock Analysis
calls.thesis: Agentic AI adds a new leg of growth on top of already sold-out capacity; record 55.8% margins; geopolitical risk premium already in valuation.
calls.base_case: DCF fair value $639 vs $445 = 43% upside over 12-18 months.
calls.bull_case: Rating reiterated as buying opportunity with conviction upgraded from medium to high.
calls.bear_case: Arizona capacity costs much higher than Taiwan; management guides declining margins ahead, though utilization has offset it for a year.
